cohort: A total of 646 pregnant women were enrolled, comprising 323 women aged >=40 years (AMA group) and 323 women <35 years (control group), attending antenatal visits at Musannah Polyclinic and AR-Rustaq General Hospital.
finding: Advanced maternal age (AMA) is strongly associated with adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including higher rates of gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, thyroid disorders, miscarriage, NICU admissions, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: AMA women had significantly lower spontaneous vaginal delivery rates and AMA was an independent predictor of cesarean delivery.
